title: the sync gate refuses a test deletion recorded in test_ids_dropped.txt when a done item of another active sprint names the test
goal: kg_sync.selector_gate, the sync gate's reading of `backlog.py selectors`, warns and does not refuse a NONE row of a done item of an active sprint whose -k selector names only test ids recorded in _tools/test_ids_dropped.txt (perfcheck.DROPPED_FILE, read with perfcheck's own reader), since a done item's check cannot be repointed (set refuses it) and the sprint review already counts such a check as gone; a NONE row of a done item whose selector names a test not recorded as dropped is still refused; kb/_self/git.md's sync gate text says so. Code-lane path (_tools/): done and the push to main come after its merge request merges (backlog.py land ID --wait-merge 1800).

run:
import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kg_sync as s
s.item_done=lambda i:True
k='test_operator_class_is_derived_from_touches_and_question_a_lower_stored_class_changes_nothing_and_secrets_fail_closed_inside_token_exceptions'
a,o=s.selector_gate('    0  NONE   -k '+k+'  ST-qivswoxw \u201ct\u201d')
b,_=s.selector_gate('    0  NONE   -k test_never_dropped_xyz  ST-qivswoxw \u201ct\u201d')
print(a,b,o);sys.exit(0 if a==0 and b==1 else 1)

notes: Premise 2026-10-16: land ST-wfrfy3mp stopped at kbgit.py sync --push, gate backlog.py selectors refused=7: done items of the active sprint SP-b36246xo (ST-qivswoxw, ST-duwzvvq7, ST-yb5x4x3d, BG-ijt2pwss, ST-2t73jxfk, ST-u2qvfapz, ST-wiv62ohc) select test_content_commit_reaches_main_and_a_red_gate_stops_the_next, test_lint_names_a_facts_line_with_a_second_bullet and test_lookup_eval_passes_on_the_live_kb, which ST-wfrfy3mp deletes under D-2tq4fhgs and records in _tools/test_ids_dropped.txt; set refuses repointing a done item's checks, and bl_land.rerun_done_checks already counts them gone. No test: the bug is proven by its repro (kb/_self/code.md, Checks and their tests).
